page.layout: No printed text on this page. Only the library stamp and show-through from the reverse side.
page.notes: The faint, upside-down lines in the centre and upper right (headings, verse, and a date "6. Martij, Anno 1656.") are show-through from the printed page on the other side, not text on this page. The round stamp of the Stadtbibliothek Zürich is a library stamp and is left out. A faint "47" at the top left is also show-through and is not transcribed as a page number. The page has no running head, catchword or signature.
